articles.title: ‘Pre-event indications’: Did Nepal miss warning signs before deadly floods?
articles.description: A glacier collapse in Nepal and China showed visible signs days before the disaster. Scientists noted brown meltwater and a propagating crack as pre-event indications. The disaster killed over 1,100 people, with more lives potentially saved by better warning systems. Comprehensive monitoring of glaciers and slopes is now stressed for vulnerable communities. Enhanced cross-border cooperation is also needed for transboundary hazard management.

articles.title: Times Square stabbing: Bank of America VP Erin Piacenti among victims
articles.description: A shocking event unfolded on Monday in Times Square as a vice president of Bank of America was violently stabbed in an unprovoked attack. Armed with kitchen knives, a woman assaulted two people before police intervened, resulting in her death. The victim's attack included a 68-year-old man who sustained injuries but remains stable. This incident underscores escalating violence against corporate professionals in Manhattan, following a series of alarming attacks.

articles.title: Amid 'very long meetings' and running chess world, has Anand lost 'hunger' to win?
articles.description: Viswanathan Anand is juggling two contrasting roles at this time. He is the interim FIDE President and also a competitive chess player. While handling increased responsibilities at world chess’s governing body, the Indian Grandmaster remains focused on the Global Chess League. Representing Alaskan Knights, Anand says his hunger to win remains strong, while his experience and routine help him balance administration, family commitments, and competitive chess.

articles.title: Markets fall sharply in early trade: Sensex down 700 points, Nifty below 23,830
articles.full_text: South Korean shares fell more than 3 per cent as the escalating US-Iran conflict pushed up oil prices and bond yields, raising concerns over the economic outlook. The KOSPI dropped 3.13%, with Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix and LG Energy Solution among the major decliners. Foreign investors were net sellers of 890.2 billion won ($649.8 million) in shares. The Korean won strengthened 0.35% against the dollar, while three- and 10-year government bond yields rose.

articles.title: Ministry of Education extends NMMS scholarship 2026-27 deadline to September 30
articles.description: The Education Ministry has extended the National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship application deadline. Students can now apply until September 30, 2026, through the National Scholarship Portal. Verification deadlines for officials have also been extended to October 15 and October 31. This scheme supports meritorious students from economically weaker sections after Class 8. Eligible students receive Rs 12,000 annually for their continued education.

articles.description: CISF ASI Paramedical admit card 2026: CISF released the ASI Paramedical Staff Recruitment 2026 PST and Documentation admit cards on September 1. The physical and documentation stage is scheduled to begin on September 14. The recruitment covers 24 posts: 18 Pharmacist, five Lab Technician and one X-Ray Technician. Candidates must download their call letters online and carry identification and original documents. The selection process includes written examination, PST, Documentation, BVAT and Medical Examination, with stage sequence subject to CISF instructions.

articles.title: Bhagyashree on motherhood and fitness
articles.description: Actress Bhagyashree opened up about her experiences with early motherhood and navigating postpartum fitness. articles.title: Who was Neem Karoli Baba?
articles.description: Vishal Chaturvedi's 'Hanuman Ansh' brings to life the spiritual journey of Neem Karoli Baba, an esteemed Hindu teacher known for his deep compassion.
